description: You woke on the slope above a shrinking waterhole. Acacias ring the mud, the grass is trampled flat for a hundred paces, and every track in the Sahel seems to end here. Water is life — and everything alive knows it, including the lions.
hazard: Lions drink here too, at dusk and dawn. You are not the biggest thing at the water.
name: Waterhole Edge

description: You woke under the baobabs, in parkland where the trees stand spaced like pillars and the grass runs gold between them. Fruit, shade, and sightlines — the savanna at its kindest. The grass hides snakes and the trees hide leopards, but every view is a gift.
hazard: Snakes in the grass, and the big cats hunt the sightlines too.
name: Baobab Parkland

description: You woke at the edge of a dead market town. Stalls stand in rows under a faded awning skeleton, a school block slumps behind them, and the clinic's red cross has weathered to pink. The pickings are old but the roofs are roofs, and the well in the square still holds water.
hazard: Old structures, old nails, old ghosts. The well water wants boiling.
name: Market Ruins
tagline: Old roofs, old shelves, a working well
